title: Source-family coverage verification (open vs controlled Ewing split: GEO/TARGET/Treehouse/cBioPortal/ICGC)
context: Before tasking per-dataset documentation, the project must verify which named source families actually hold open-access Ewing data and which only hold controlled-access data. This resolves the open question of whether TARGET/GDC holds an open Ewing cohort at all. The output is a candidate shortlist, but listing a candidate never pre-approves it — each still requires its own gate-003 artifact. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Produce a committed coverage report recording the open vs controlled Ewing split per source family and a ranked candidate shortlist of plausibly-open datasets.
acceptanceCriteria: For each named source family (GEO, TARGET/GDC, Treehouse, cBioPortal, ICGC) record whether it holds open-access Ewing data, with cited evidence and the open vs controlled split.
Explicitly resolves the TARGET question (does an open Ewing cohort exist?); if not, recommends dropping TARGET from the source families with rationale recorded.
Output is a committed candidate shortlist (>= 6 plausibly-open Ewing datasets) ordered by a realistic adoption path, each still requiring its own gate-003 artifact before tasking.
